There are many open and hidden grottos located throughout Hyrule. Many of them contain helpful or valuable items.

== Pink Fairy Fountains ==

Fairies are useful for restoring your health, and even reviving you when you lose all of your hearts and die. If you are low on health, or have a bottle to keep one for later, the following locations will be the best places to find a fairy quickly.

#Desert Colossus: Go to rock where dried up pool and palm trees are and play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Song of Storms}} and pool will fill up with water making fairies appear.
#Gerudo Fortress: Out the door where you rescued the first carpenter with another door to left play {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Song of Storms}} and hole will open drop in to find fairy fountain.
#Hyrule Field: Across stream to west smash boulder with {{im/oot|Items|Megaton Hammer}}.
#Graveyard: Grave with flowers in the front down behind chest {{im/oot|Items|Bomb|display=bomb}} wall and follow corridor.
#Scared Forest Meadow: Climb ladder at end of maze and drop into hole down another ladder and you will find the fairy fountain.
#Zora's River: {{im/oot|Items|Bomb}} boulder on highest place.
#Zora's Domain: On island in water play {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Song of Storms}} and drop in hole that appears to find a fairy fountain.
